items.title: Computer security
items.description: The Computer Security program at LETI focuses on protecting computer systems, networks, and data from cyber threats. Students study cybersecurity, cryptography, network security, programming, operating systems, and information protection. The program combines theoretical knowledge with practical skills and prepares graduates for careers in cybersecurity, information security, and IT

items.title: Software engineering
items.description: The Software Engineering program at SPbPU focuses on the design, development, testing, and maintenance of software systems. Students study programming, algorithms, databases, software architecture, web technologies, and project management. The program combines theoretical foundations with practical development skills and prepares graduates for careers in software engineering, IT, and related technology fields

items.title: Full-stack developer
items.description: Worked on a cryptocurrency exchange platform, integrating blockchain nodes into microservices, building a P2P crypto-to-fiat exchange service from scratch, and developing new features for both the back-office system and frontend

items.title: Solidity blockchain developer
items.description: Solidity Developer with experience building smart contracts for DeFi protocols, including Uniswap, Compound, vesting, stablecoin, and bridge solutions. Worked on developing, testing, and improving DEX and bridge contracts, automating contract deployment and upgrades, and maintaining smart contract development libraries
